decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a surface variant of Dallmer's core drainage portfolio, so it builds directly on existing knowledge, and moving from a mention to a dedicated page in 2024 points to market traction the firm can interpret and expand.

CeraFrame Liquid extends the firm's established shower-channel line to seamless coverings, a growing trend the firm can serve with its own R&D and installer feedback, and it has kept a dedicated page for two years.

The pump-drain shower channel draws on the firm's channel expertise and on what it learned when it withdrew the earlier pump-assisted solution, so it is a refined second attempt worth giving more time, despite somewhat higher risk in the pump segment.
